title: To review
intro: Transactions that reached your email. Review and accept them to record them.

item.failed: We couldn't record it. Try again.

connection.label: Transactions by email
connection.hint: Record your bank alerts from your email
connection.unavailable: This feature isn't available yet. Coming soon.
connection.pitch: We'll give you your own address. Forward your bank alerts there and they'll show up here for you to confirm.
connection.createFailed: We couldn't create your address. Try again.

steps.gmail: In Gmail go to Settings → Forwarding and POP/IMAP → Add a forwarding address and paste it. The confirmation code will show up here.
steps.filter: Create a filter with your bank's address in “From” and choose “Forward it to” your address.
steps.done: Done. We recognize {banks} and learn other banks when you accept their transactions.

connection.sendersHint: Your banks' addresses or domains. The ones you accept are added automatically; the ones you dismiss several times get blocked.
connection.senderFailed: That address or domain isn't valid.

gmail.pitch: Link your Gmail and as soon as a bank alert arrives you'll see it here, ready to confirm. No forwarding or filters.
gmail.privacy: We only read emails from {banks} and the senders you add. We never send or delete anything, and you can disconnect anytime.
gmail.listening: Listening to your inbox. Alerts from {banks} and your senders will show up in “To review”.
gmail.revoked: Google no longer gives us access to this email (you removed the permission or changed your password). Reconnect it to keep receiving your transactions.
gmail.disconnectFailed: We couldn't disconnect it. Try again.

result.connected: Gmail connected. Your next alerts will show up in “To review”.
result.scope_denied: We need permission to read your emails. Try again and check the Gmail box.
result.taken: That Gmail is already connected to another Zentlet account.
result.unavailable: The Gmail connection isn't available yet.
result.error: We couldn't connect your Gmail. Try again.
